visual_argument: One door or two. A glass passage that forks carries the deck: a fly at its mouth, four identical flies in four cells, the Y that keeps one kind and frees the rest, then today's single exits (a rack of one tube per trap and a dead end jar, a one way bucket trap in brush with the released flies streaming past), the Kerrville and Edinburg relief where another AI picks the release, forty bales for forty projects, a fence post per month to June 2028, and a producer's phone at the close.
build_risk: Frame 3 must render transmissive borosilicate glass that reads as glass on a studio sweep, with one fly behind a gold band in the keep chamber and three flies and a beetle leaving the open branch, and never imply a camera, flap or mechanism.
distinct_from_recent: November 18th was a survey satellite, stake grids and reliefs of air and stone in the explainer tone; November 17th a violet scoring machine, card drawer and paper towers in watch; November 16th a gold ribbon and caliper; October 18th told the same parasite from USDA's side in bluebonnet with a tank, a trap and release boxes. This deck is the wonder tone, macro glass and studio work turning into brush country and a pasture, with type in at least six places.
